claim_scores.rationale: It calls `OpenAIProvider.finetune` with `model='openai/gpt-4o-mini'` and asserts the captured remote-training model is `'gpt-4o-mini'`, proving the prefix was stripped first.
It patches `OpenAIProvider._start_remote_training` with `fake_start` and captures the `model` argument that `finetune` forwards into the remote training call.
It keeps the fine-tuning path offline by stubbing `upload_data`, `_start_remote_training`, `wait_for_job`, and `get_trained_model`, covering the provider-facing lifecycle steps around `finetune`.
It asserts `captured['model'] == 'gpt-4o-mini'` and `result == 'ft:gpt-4o-mini:demo'`, matching the expected stripped model ID and mocked trained-model return.
